description.text: Wayra is Telefónica's Corporate Venture Capital and open innovation platform. We invest in AI, connectivity and cybersecurity startups.

targetApplicants.text: We invest in startups with the potential to generate real impact within Telefónica and help them scale through commercial collaboration. Our venture-client model connects startups with Telefónica’s business units, opening access to global markets and one of the largest customer bases in the world. Discover how we can grow together.

Growth is the goal. OUTLIERS 2026: Discover the startups that are already shaping the future Our mission is to foster innovation and drive progress by investing in startups and connecting them with organisations to generate impact in Spain, Germany, the United Kingdom and Brazil. We invest in startups with the potential to generate real impact within Telefónica and help them scale through commercial collaboration. Our venture-client model connects startups with Telefónica’s business units, opening access to global markets and one of the largest customer bases in the world. Our experience allows us to design and deliver open innovation and corporate venture programmes for Telefónica and other corporations, either directly or through our open innovation platforms. Explore how we can build your innovation strategy together. Ready to scale, collaborate or just get to know us ? Let´s talk!
